method: Ran under frozen spec tag p3-pipeline-bench-v2 on llama-3.1-8b. Independent re-derivation of R2 false acceptances against value_gate; frozen-grader agreement check on T4 scoring. No post-hoc change.

r2.method_note: Single pipeline pass per case (5 candidates + deterministic ranking), not multi-round closure. first_pass is therefore 'resolved within the single pass' and is not comparable to run_task round counts.
r2.sim_stage: not-run on all 20 (no sim back-end for these cases) — recorded, not claimed
r2.track_verdict: PASS — bar cleared (8 >= 4) with zero false acceptances, independently re-derived.

t4.note: All 20 samples selected 'A'. Forcing bare-letter answers removed the free-form reasoning that was the only mechanism the 8B had; the structural constraint actively harmed this track.
t4.track_verdict: FAIL — and a regression vs the 14/20 single-shot baseline.

status: PARTIAL — exactly one track passes: recorded as a track-specific improvement finding per the frozen spec. NOT an overall pass.
system_conclusion: Structure helps where the verifier is exact and deterministic (R2: computed constraint + value gate), and harms where format freedom was load-bearing (T4: bare letters stripped the reasoning the grader's examples rely on). The load-bearing variable is verifier exactness, not model scale.

walls.r2: NARROWED by the pipeline (0 -> 8 closes) but the wall is not declared cleared: the frozen protocol requires the overall pass, and T4 regressed; R2 repeatability also remains to be shown on an expanded set per plan.
walls.t4: STANDS — and the pipeline is a wrong direction for it on this model.
